title: AI Chatbot Fails: Eating Disorder Advice Gone Wrong #shorts
description: A prominent organization replaced human counselors with an AI chatbot, which immediately began advising users to count calories—a dangerous directive for those with eating disorders. This highlights the risks of relying on AI trained on average internet data. #AI #MentalHealth #EatingDisorders #Healthcare #Technology
